title: Discounts
description: Manage promotional codes and automatic discounts.

help.title: About discounts
help.overview: Discount codes customers type in at checkout. A cart takes one code at a time, and the code is checked again whenever the cart changes.

sections.title: Kinds
items: Percentage or fixed amount off, never more than the items are worth.
Free shipping: no shipping charge while the code is used.
Buy X get Y: in each complete set, the cheapest items are free.
It covers the whole order, or only chosen products, categories or collections. Gift cards are never discounted.

sections.title: When a code doesn't work
items: Outside its start and end dates, or after Deactivate.
Once its usage limit is reached, overall or per customer. A use counts when the order is placed.
Below the minimum order amount or minimum quantity.
Customer groups saved on a discount aren't checked.
